g.text: Resnik: IC of the most informative

text.style: fill: #1a1a1a; font: 7.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

path.style: fill: none; stroke: #5b6670; stroke-width: 0.7; stroke-linejoin: miter; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: MVA1 covers 3 of 7 proband terms by HPO annotation (rhabdomyosarcoma, short stature, small for gestational age) and leaves 4 uncovered (failure to thrive, premature birth, skeletal muscle atrophy, nephrocalcinosis); 0 of 12 models cover all 7.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Nephrocalcinosis is uncovered by all three MVA models. Its best match 1.5 bits against its own IC of 3.9, while 5 of the 9 neighbour models do cover it, and it is the only term with neither annotation nor literature support.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Annotation bias is not corrected here: a poorly annotated disease scores low even where the trait occurs. Columns are the nearest models to the FULL profile, not a search for renal models.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: end
